# 3. NEEDS ANALYSIS

**Motor Insurance – Excess Structure Review**

The client contacted the FSP by telephone to enquire regarding the feasibility of reducing the excess on their existing motor insurance policy with Santam. The specific need identified was to explore options for lowering the current excess amount to reduce out-of-pocket exposure in the event of a claim. The client's risk profile remains unchanged from the original policy inception: the vehicle continues to be used for personal purposes, with no material change in usage patterns, driver composition, or claims history reported. The client expressed concern regarding excess liability but did not indicate financial hardship or change in financial capacity. Following explanation of the excess buy-down option (which would increase monthly premium by approximately R85), the client made an informed decision to retain the existing excess structure, confirming satisfaction with the current cover and cost-benefit trade-off.

---

# 4. MARKET COMPARISON

Market Comparison – Not applicable – this is telephone advice regarding an amendment to an existing policy and no new market comparison was required or conducted.

---

# 5. PRODUCT RECOMMENDED

**Insurer:** Santam Limited

**Policy Type:** Personal Motor Insurance (Existing Policy – Amendment Advice)

**Section 9(1) Statutory Disclosure – Santam Motor Policy**

• Insured Peril: Loss or damage to motor vehicle arising from accident, theft, hijacking, fire, or malicious act

• Sum Insured: To be confirmed from existing policy schedule (not amended by this advice)

• Excess Structure (Current – Retained by Client):
  ◦ Standard excess: As per existing policy schedule
  ◦ Optional excess buy-down available at approximately R85 per month additional premium (declined by client)
  ◦ No change recommended; client elected to maintain current excess following full explanation of cost-benefit trade-off

• Exclusions – Standard Motor Policy:
  ◦ Loss or damage arising from mechanical or electrical breakdown
  ◦ Loss or damage caused by wear and tear
  ◦ Damage arising from racing, speed testing, or trial events
  ◦ Loss or damage while vehicle is being used for commercial hire or reward purposes
  ◦ Loss arising from deliberate acts of the insured
  ◦ Liability arising from contractual assumption unless arising from negligence
  ◦ Loss or damage in respect of unspent fuel in tank (standard exclusion applies)
  ◦ Any losses excluded by express policy wording

• SASRIA Cover:
  ◦ SASRIA (South African Special Risks Insurance Association) riot, strike and civil commotion cover available as optional add-on
  ◦ Not amended by this advice; status to be confirmed from existing policy documentation
  ◦ Client may request inclusion if not currently in force

• Claims Conditions:
  ◦ Insured must notify insurer within 30 days of loss or damage (or as soon as reasonably practicable)
  ◦ Insured must cooperate fully with investigations and provide all relevant documentation
  ◦ No admission of liability to be made without insurer's written consent

• Premium Impact of Recommendation:
  ◦ No premium change – existing excess structure retained as per client instruction
  ◦ Option to implement excess buy-down remains available at R85 monthly increase should client reconsider

---

# 6. REMUNERATION AND CONFLICT OF INTEREST DECLARATION

**FSP and Representative Remuneration:**

• This advice is provided by [FSP Name and Registration Number] represented by [Representative Name and Registration Number]

• Remuneration earned from Santam for this advice:
  ◦ Existing commission structure continues on ongoing premium
  ◦ No additional commission earned as result of excess buy-down recommendation decline
  ◦ Commission earned: [X]% of monthly premium or [R amount] per annum

• Other Remuneration:
  ◦ No fees charged directly to client for telephone advice
  ◦ No additional benefits, incentives, or soft commissions received in relation to this advice

**Conflicts of Interest:**

• Declared Conflict:
  ◦ FSP receives ongoing commission from Santam on this policy
  ◦ Potential conflict exists insofar as FSP financial interest may be served by retention of policy with Santam rather than switching to alternative insurer
  ◦ This conflict has been mitigated by provision of market comparison advice at original policy placement

• Conflict Mitigation Measures Implemented:
  ◦ Telephone advice provided objectively based on client's stated need (excess reduction feasibility)
  ◦ Client provided with transparent information regarding cost-benefit of excess buy-down option
  ◦ No pressure applied to purchase additional cover or accept FSP recommendation
  ◦ Client's autonomous decision to retain existing structure respected and documented

• Cooling-Off Rights:
  ◦ Client entitled to cancel or amend policy within 30 days of amendment implementation (if implemented) in accordance with FAIS Act requirements

---

# 7. REPLACEMENT ADVICE

**Replacement Advice Declaration:**

• This telephone advice does not constitute a recommendation to replace the existing Santam motor policy

• No alternative insurer has been recommended or compared

• Advice relates solely to optional amendment (excess buy-down) to existing policy with Santam

• Client has elected not to implement excess buy-down amendment

• Existing Santam policy continues on current terms and conditions

• No Replacement Advice Schedule is therefore required for this transaction

---
